item.title: Poland: Thousands protest for more abortion rights
item.description: Thousands rallied across Poland to demand abortion rights six years after a landmark court ruling tightened restrictions. The country has one of the strictest abortion rules in all of Europe.
item.dc:subject: News

item.title: Albania's student protests are only getting bigger
item.description: As police try to suppress anti-corruption protests by young Albanians, Prime Minister Edi Rama is claiming that "antifa" is behind the unrest. Few are buying that explanation.
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: Germany arrests Ukrainian man suspected of spying for Russia
item.description: The suspect is thought to have gathered defense-related information on the production of tanks and munitions, as well as details about NATO's eastern flank.
